about: A small labelled set for meaning-based recall. Synthetic: invented people, places and numbers. A 'paraphrase' question shares no word of four or more letters with the note it should find; a 'keyword' question does; an 'unrelated' question has no right note and should match none.

notes.text: The quarterly tax filing is due on the fifteenth of the month after the quarter ends.
Maya is allergic to peanuts and carries an epinephrine pen.
The office printer on the third floor jams whenever it is asked to print double-sided.
Our production database is backed up every night at two in the morning.
Dad's birthday is on the ninth of March and he likes dark chocolate.
The Lisbon flight leaves from terminal two and boarding closes forty minutes before departure.
The landlord requires sixty days written notice before the lease ends.
Weekly team sync happens on Tuesday at ten, in the blue meeting room.
The dog Biscuit needs her vaccinations renewed every spring.
Expense reports above five hundred euros need a second approver.
The new hire starts on Monday and needs a laptop and a badge.
Solar panels on the garage roof produce most of their power between noon and three.
The gym membership renews automatically in January and costs forty-five a month.
Customer Acme prefers invoices in euros and pays within thirty days.
The staging server listens on port 8081 and resets every Sunday.
Grandma's apple cake recipe uses cinnamon, brown sugar and a splash of rum.
The car needs an oil change every ten thousand kilometres.
Passwords for the shared accounts are rotated at the end of every quarter by the security team.
The conference talk is twenty minutes long with five minutes for questions.
Sam is vegetarian and does not eat fish either.
The bakery on Elm Street closes at four on Saturdays.
Our mobile app must support the two most recent major versions of the phone's operating system.
The yearly performance review conversation takes place in November.
Heating in the old building is switched off over the weekend to save money.
The garden hose is stored in the shed behind the compost heap.
Delivery of the new desks is expected the week before Christmas.
The marathon training plan has a long run every Sunday morning.
Interns are not allowed to deploy to production without a mentor present.
The credit card statement closes on the twentieth and payment is due ten days later.
Emma's piano lesson is on Thursday afternoon at a quarter past four.
Customer data older than seven years must be deleted under the retention policy.
The ferry to the island runs only twice a day in winter.
The coffee machine in the kitchen needs descaling once a month.
Our main competitor launched a cheaper plan last spring.
Visitors must sign in at the front desk and wear a visitor pass.
The wifi password for guests is posted by the reception and changes monthly.
